app.name: Collections Workspace
app.description: Chase overdue invoices on live Business Central data, side by side with the Collections agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot.
app.aiDescription: For finance collections specialists. Covers Business Central customers and posted sales invoices (read live through virtual tables), overdue worklists, aging dashboards shared with the Collections agent, and confirmed follow-ups. Excludes sales, purchasing and anything that writes to Business Central.

entities.description: Shared state between the Collections agent, its Copilot widget and the app: one aging-dashboard spec (JSON) per row; last write wins on Version.
entities.iconDescription: a bar chart with three ascending bars and a small clock in the corner

columns.description: DashboardSpec v1 as JSON (packages/contract/src/dashboard.ts); written by the agent's tool and by the PCF.
Monotonic revision of the spec; the higher version wins when the agent and the app both edit.
Business Central customer number when the dashboard is scoped to one customer; empty for portfolio dashboards.

entities.description: Audit trail of every agent action the app handled, rejected or failed, plus follow-ups (promises to pay) the specialist confirmed. Never written to Business Central.
entities.iconDescription: a clipboard with a check mark and a small speech bubble

columns.description: Bridge action that triggered the row, e.g. Contoso.Collections.LogFollowUp.
Business Central customer number the action was about.
Validated action payload as received from the agent, kept for audit.
Specialist's note for a follow-up, e.g. what the customer promised on the call.
Date the customer promised to pay; drives the next follow-up.
Amount the customer promised to pay, in the invoice currency.
handled | rejected | cancelled | failed | confirmed: how the app dealt with the action.
agent | user: who initiated the action.

views.name: Recent dashboards
views.description: Dashboards built by the agent or edited in the app, newest first.

views.name: Confirmed follow-ups
views.description: Promises to pay the specialist confirmed, by promise date: tomorrow's call list.

views.name: Agent action log
views.description: Every agent action the app received, newest first, including rejected ones: the audit trail for governance.

forms.name: Collection dashboard
forms.description: Inspect a shared dashboard spec (normally edited through the agent or the PCF).

forms.name: Collection action
forms.description: Review one audited agent action or confirmed follow-up.

jobs.name: Build and share aging dashboards with the agent
